title: AirPrompter slot store — store.json
description: The host's record of what it holds (D35, S8): the active and staged slots, the generation, the accepted root document, the wrapped store key, and — from format 2 — the apply-policy pin (S4) and the writer. store.json is a cross-package contract: the daemon binary writes it and the application's SDK reads it, and they deploy on different days. The N/N-1 rule (store-format.md): a reader at format N accepts N and N-1, writes N, migrates an N-1 file forward on its first write, and refuses N+1 with `store_newer` naming the writer. No prompt text is ever in store.json; the slots' manifests and encrypted payloads live beside it.

writer.description: Format 2: the package that last wrote the file, so a reader that meets a newer format can name what wrote it.

applyPolicyPin.description: S4: the apply policy this host holds — trust-on-first-use from a manifest, tightened by a later one, loosened only by an operator.

instanceId.description: The store's own identity — the seed of the runRef key every process on the host shares (S6). Never a process's instance id.

wrappedDek.description: The store key, wrapped by the key provider; base64url.

root.description: The last accepted root document (key-set.schema.json), or null until one is accepted.

v1.description: Format 1 (0.2.0–0.2.5): read by readers at format 2 (N-1), written by nothing current.

v2.description: Format 2 (S8): format 1 plus the writer and the apply-policy pin.
